description: This file defines the ConfigureSectionForm class in Drupal, which provides a form for configuring layout sections within the layout builder module. It includes methods for building, validating, and submitting the form, as well as managing layout plugins and section data.

classes.name: ConfigureSectionForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for configuring layout sections within the layout builder module, handling form building, validation, and submission logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for layout tempstore repository and plugin form factory.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for a layout section, setting up form elements and AJAX behaviors.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form by delegating to the layout plugin's validation method.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, saving configuration and redirecting.

methods.name: successfulAjaxSubmit
methods.description: Handles AJAX submission success, rebuilding and closing the form.

methods.name: getPluginForm
methods.description: Retrieves the plugin form for a given layout plugin.

methods.name: getCurrentLayout
methods.description: Returns the current layout plugin being configured.

methods.name: getCurrentSection
methods.description: Returns the section object being configured, creating it if necessary.
